origin.example:
p <- tempfile()
cat("hi\n", file = p)
expect_known_output(cat("hi\n"), p)
"ok"

translation.details: Captured output matches a file. code is a callable. local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
from testthat import *

p = tempfile.mktemp()
open(p, "w").write("hi\n")
expect_known_output(lambda: print("hi"), p)
return "ok"
